expected_findings.rationale: The brand name Riverside Mills appears on the front panel, but no full name and UK address of the food business operator appears anywhere on the pack.

trap: A decorative brand name on the front panel can be mistaken for a compliant food business operator declaration, which requires a full name and a UK address.
notes: Tests whether the system requires an actual address, not just a brand name, to satisfy the food business operator rule.
